title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Two Hundred Thousand Pesos for the Employment of Temporary Personnel in the Bureau of Posts During the Period from February to June, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Six
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Two Hundred Thousand Pesos for the Employment of Temporary Personnel in the Bureau of Posts During the Period from February to June, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Six

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1413_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury of the Philippines not otherwise appropriated, for the employment of temporary personnel of the Bureau of Posts in Manila and in the different post offices in the Philippines during the period from February to June, nineteen hundred fifty-six.

This Act shall take effect as of February 1, 1956.
Approved: April 21, 1956.
